sealed_principle: Files under data/sealed/ are downloaded after the freeze by code/fetch_holdout.py, hashed, and never opened by any code path except code/confirm.py. fetch_holdout.py additionally records only each file's header line / sheet names into data/sealed/headers.json - structure, never values - so that confirm.py can map registered column patterns onto real headers without inspecting score rows.

datasets.name: in4mer_unified
datasets.source: figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.24243832 - Esmaeili Anvar et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Table 1: unified dLFC + Cohen's d re-scoring of the five published combinatorial studies (Dede 2020, Thompson 2021, Parrish pgPEN 2021, CHyMErA 2020, Ito 2021) plus the in4mer/Inzolia screens
datasets.published_sl_rule: dLFC <= -0.5 AND Cohen's d <= -1.0 within one cell line, or the row's own SL hit flag where one is provided

datasets.name: pgpen_direct
datasets.file_resolution: Parrish et al. 2021 Cell Reports (DOI 10.1016/j.celrep.2021.109597), PMC8534300 supplement files 2-8. PMC filenames do not carry table labels, so every candidate is fetched sealed and confirm.py tries each against the column patterns below; the file that parses to a nonempty pair table IS treated as this dataset's table and recorded in the run. If several parse, the one containing the widest pair set is used.
datasets.published_sl_rule: GI <= -0.5 AND FDR <= 0.1 per cell line; where an FDR column exists it is used, else the GI threshold alone

datasets.name: flister_36648
datasets.unavailable_note: Cell Reports 2025 (DOI 10.1016/j.celrep.2025.116512, PMID 41205176): supplementary Table S2 (36,648 pairs, enAsCas12a, NCI-H1299 and MDA-MB-231). No open repository deposit or directly fetchable supplement URL could be established before the freeze; the dataset stays registered and is skipped with disclosure if it remains unfetchable. If it is fetched the file lands under data/sealed/ like every holdout file.
datasets.published_sl_rule: pair observed dKO below additive single-KO expectation at the paper's registered threshold; where a hit/FDR column exists it takes precedence

line_models_note: Empty list = line not a DepMap model, so its context status is 'unknown' and the pair contributes only unconditional evidence there. Context status uses the same binarisation and thresholds as discovery, computed by code/confirm.py from the shared omics only.
